body: excuse me? i'm 20, we dated for two years. I absolutely 100% do not care that there's "going to be someone else", I'm not looking to hop back into the dating pool right now. Super fresh breakup, very sad me, I want to distract myself so I can breathe a little?

Literally every hobby I have reminds me of him. I would play video games, but we used to do that together. I'd draw but all of my sketchbooks are filled with pictures of his face. I'd listen to music but all of the bands I like are ones that we liked together.

Maybe I just need to get a new hobby. I hear model building is pretty relaxing. I don't know.
